conventions.layerName: Paper layer name is canonical. Variants use a dot suffix (OBSetRow.done). A block may map to a shared widget or an inline composition; the Dart owner need not match the Paper name.
conventions.canonical: The node on the Bausteine page is canonical. Screens contain clones; a visual change is made on the Bausteine node first, then re-applied to the widget, then screens are re-derived.
conventions.package: Existing ui2 code is reused — not every Paper block is a class in lib/openband. implementationStatus is explicit when the block is not in source; absent status means implemented when file and widget resolve.
conventions.honesty: Absent input renders as — or is omitted. Partial totals are labeled; no ≥ prefix or invented length for unknown amounts. Progress requires an actual saved target.
conventions.sourceCheck: tool/check_design_manifest.py verifies that implemented file/widget references exist in source. It does not verify routing or visual acceptance.

blocks.name: OBPageHeader.hub
blocks.replaces: OBPageHeader (rewrite: title only, 'Heute' when today, 'Di, 15. Sep.' otherwise; no eyebrow)
blocks.notes: Inline hub titles in OpenBandOverview / OpenBandHealth / OpenBandTraining / OpenBandJournal; not OBPageHeader.

blocks.name: OBPageHeader.detail
blocks.notes: Canonical 64-point header,44-point card circles,18/24 title and12/16 subtitle. When the longest title word cannot fit between controls at the current text scale, including the measured width of a text back button, controls keep their44-point row and the full-width heading follows8 points below. Exercise detail reuses the optional trailing action for Lucide copy, with the Kopieren accessibility label; copied definitions return to the same library unselected. Root setup omits Back when there is no previous route; its44-point leading slot preserves alignment.

blocks.name: OBBandCapsule
blocks.notes: Battery % and connection dot are independent facts; dot colour = recovery when connected, gap when not.

blocks.name: OBIconButton
blocks.notes: Overview and OBPageHeader use OBKey for the raised header controls.

blocks.name: OBMetricCard
blocks.notes: Borderless card, radius24, padding14, minimum112; value/unit share a baseline and stack only when needed. Null omits the unit. Compact typed night states remain visible; comparison requires current complete data and an explicitly trusted stored baseline. No invented range marker or comparison arrow. Optional decimal precision preserves respiration values and baseline deltas; default integer formatting stays unchanged. Temperature uses typed SD or Celsius and signed SD formatting; unknown quantities show — without a unit.

blocks.name: OBStatusChip
blocks.notes: Text only: '+8 über Basis', '-2 unter Basis' or 'wie Basis'. Compact cards omit an unsupported comparison; detail retains source and baseline qualification.

blocks.name: OBTrendCard
blocks.notes: Historical partial input is retained and qualified in the observed-count caption and semantics. No comparison claim from a partial series.

blocks.name: OBTrendPlot
blocks.notes: Baseline band, dotted mean, polyline, dashed gap marker, endpoint dot. Two axis labels only. Plot is inline in OBTrendCard via _TrendPainter; no OBTrendPlot type. Scalar baseline is a line, never an invented range band.

blocks.name: OBWeekBars
blocks.notes: Today = dashed outline bar.

blocks.name: OBHypnogram
blocks.notes: Drawn by NightChart._NightPainter; no OBHypnogram class.

blocks.name: OBStageLegend
blocks.notes: Adaptive five-stage facts in the Sleep hero. Actual stored durations or —; no Im Bett swatch. Equal measured columns use 8px gaps for five columns or 12px otherwise; 16px row gap. Labels Inter 12/14, values Inter Tight 17/20. At 375px and 2x text, two columns preserve full-size text. Canonical board instance 4XSP-0 replaces obsolete 3EX4-0. Full Sleep-page parity remains open. At375px/1x, four columns wrap Im Bett into the next row.

blocks.name: OBSectionHeader
blocks.notes: Inline section titles on hubs; no OBSectionHeader class.

blocks.name: OBSectionHeader.range

blocks.name: OBListCard
blocks.notes: List grouping uses OBCard; no OBListCard class.

blocks.name: OBListRow
blocks.notes: Training session rows; overview also uses inline _ActionRow. No OBListRow class.

blocks.name: OBLens
blocks.notes: 36×36, radius 12, metric tint background, 18 px Lucide icon in metric colour. 36×36 metric tint icon is inline in OpenBandOverview; no OBLens class.

blocks.name: OBActionDestructive
blocks.note: OBAction secondary with destructive foreground; shared alarm and editor action.

blocks.name: OBSegmented
blocks.notes: Shared full-width 40-point visual well inside a 44-point target; centered 14/18 labels. Measurement uses selected weight. Stacks at narrow width or large text; compact g/% retains its own sizing.

blocks.name: OBChip
blocks.notes: Status pill is inline in OpenBandOverview; no OBChip class.

blocks.name: OBLiveChip
blocks.notes: White pill, strain dot, timer in strain colour. Never alp-ink surface. GPS chip is inline in the OpenBandRunLive AppBar; no OBLiveChip class.

blocks.name: OBEmptyState
blocks.notes: Title + stated reason + one action. Inline empty-session card; no OBEmptyState class.

blocks.name: OBSleepHero
blocks.notes: Hero is inline in OpenBandSleep; no OBSleepHero class.

blocks.name: OBProfileRow
blocks.notes: Shared identity card in the compact ProfileHomeView; no second profile implementation.

blocks.name: OBBandCard
blocks.notes: Datenstand (band), Gespeichert (iPhone receipt) and Archiv are independent facts. Band card is inline on ProfileHomeView; no OBBandCard class. Large-text facts use stacked value/label rows to avoid broken words; production acceptance tracked in release-data.

blocks.name: OBSettingsGroup
blocks.note: One shared settingsGroup function; optional heading and outer padding preserve existing defaults. Compact Profile and Data reuse the same card/dividers.

blocks.name: OBSettingsRow
blocks.note: SetRow uses52-point default rows and a60-point subtitle variant for Data. Both grow with content; existing controls and value alignment are shared.

blocks.name: OBCalendar
blocks.notes: Shared Monday-first44-point calendar. The G2 day picker uses single-letter weekdays and round month wells; other callers retain their headers. Sleep selection retains night dots and disables future days; goal dates enable future days and omit metric dots. Canonical future variant3WKQ-0. Adjacent-month cells remain empty. Optional lastDate caps civil-day selection and forward month navigation independently of the real today marker; allowFuture=false also retains the today cap.

blocks.name: OBDayPreview
blocks.notes: The G2 day picker keeps its selected-night preview inline in _DayPicker: civil date, preceding-to-selected night label, and stored duration or an explicit dash. The inset preview and fixed confirmation preserve cancel-without-selection. No OBDayPreview class.

blocks.name: OBSyncState
blocks.note: Stored frontier and real transfer state only; no invented progress track. Interactive states use44-point targets; large text stacks the action. FirstSync adds actual resume pending/failure state without changing storage or BLE ownership.

blocks.name: OBStepsHours
blocks.note: 24 feste Stundenfächer; leere vergangene Stunden als Spur, Zukunft grau. Hour buckets via stepsByHour, drawn in StepsCard; no OBStepsHours class.

blocks.name: OBMetricHero
blocks.note: Stored nightly HRV/RHR scalar, unit and honest state; no invented range. Comparison only for an explicitly trusted stored baseline. Correction-pending or unproven values remain behind Info.

blocks.name: OBNightBars
blocks.note: Actual stored nights in a civil 7/30/90-day window, anchored to the selected stored algorithm. Explicit gaps; actual scalar baseline line. No interpolation, invented spread band or decorative gap markers. Seven-night bars are14px wide (rounded7px ends);30-night bars remain6px and90-night bars fit their actual calendar slots. Missing nights keep their slots.

blocks.name: OBNoticeCard
blocks.note: Kein eigener Paper-Block — Status-/Hinweiskarte, geteilt von Einrichtung und OpenBand.

blocks.name: OBPairCard
blocks.notes: G2 setup hero:126-point inset illustration well,76-point raised device circles, four link dots, concise phase-specific status and three-step progress strip. Typed permission/recovery states preserve their actual cause.

blocks.name: OBFormCard
blocks.implemented: _Field — Label 13/600 muted, Wert Inter Tight 24/700, Einheit
blocks.notes: Form is ProfileSetupView wrapping _Field rows; no OBFormCard class.

blocks.name: OBNightSignalChart
blocks.notes: Uses OBCard and the existing metric hero type scale. Selected stored value only; pulse and respiration union same-version calendar bundles intersecting the actual night. Conflicting timestamps stay null. No invented averages, baseline, or coverage percentage; available calendar curves remain partial.

blocks.name: OBTrendPlot.night
blocks.notes: Extends the OBTrendPlot visual language with absolute timestamps, source cadence breaks, stored HRV bounds, and nearest stored-point selection. No X markers, gap lines, smoothing, or interpolation of selected values.

blocks.name: OBSegmented.night
blocks.notes: Existing shared selector; only labels and selected index change. Height grows with system text size.

blocks.name: OBSettingsRow.toggle
blocks.notes: Canonical 56-point toggle row with a 44-point switch target; schedule variant remains64. Dark off track uses alp-line. Large text stacks controls.

blocks.name: OBNapRow
blocks.notes: Fixed icon and duration lanes; stacks duration under time at large text. Missing stored duration remains —. G2 Nickerchen keeps the dated day pill and add action anchored above the safe area while the list scrolls.

blocks.name: OBTimeField.well
blocks.notes: Shared controller-backed time field; paired wells stack when text needs more width.

blocks.name: OBSettingsRow.value
blocks.notes: Shared value/navigation row. Compact notification metrics unchanged; comfortable goal variant uses64 minimum,14/20 padding,15/20 label and card-radius ink. Empty-value large-text label wraps beside chevron. Long values wrap at normal and large text; empty choices remain explicit. Empty-value navigation rows keep a fixed trailing chevron at all text scales; value-bearing rows retain the shared large-text stacked layout. Leading icon variant uses a36-point fixed tile,12-point label gap and56-point normal minimum. Existing compact/comfortable variants retain their layout. Leading value–chevron gap is12; existing non-leading gap remains4. Optional source/date subtitle wraps. Dated journal-weight entries use this same row, with regular date and medium muted value; large text follows the canonical stack.

blocks.name: OBSettingsChoiceSheet
blocks.notes: Canonical generic choice sheet shared by notification thresholds and explicit exercise equipment, capture mode, load and repetition basis; selected choice only, fixed check lane. Canonical bottom padding includes20 points plus the device safe area; native cycle-gap chooser verified at375/393px and2x text.

blocks.name: OBTimePicker
blocks.notes: Shared stock input-only time dialog with Alpin card/well/ink, 296×264 at1x and112×72 fields. Platform locale/24h and accessible input retained; no dial. Invalid entry stays open; cancellation returns no change.

blocks.name: OBSettingsChoiceRow
blocks.notes: Shared explicit choices for theme and notification sheets:48 minimum row,15 regular/600 selected,18 fixed check lane. Theme choice changes after durable save.

blocks.name: OBSetupStatusCard
blocks.notes: Three independent source facts: connection, receiving state or stored frontier, and current-local-day evaluation. Receiving adds a raised stored-frontier card; no oldest timestamp or total transfer range is available, so no positioned progress is drawn. Shared48 minimum rows,20 icon lane,12 gap,15 labels/values. Current job failure/pending remains separate from successful recalculation. Native acceptance is recorded separately.

blocks.name: OBConfirmSheet
blocks.notes: Shared discard/remove sheet; optional short body explains which dated target boundary will change. Close/cancel retain draft. Paper canonical and Journal/goal clones reconciled to source:32% scrim and12px content bottom plus34px example safe area; no Flutter confirmation behavior changed.

blocks.name: OBSleepNeedSummary
blocks.notes: G2 Messleiste starts at 0–10 h and extends for larger stored values or goals, with a raised case and three input rows. Stored coming-night forecast only; current civil day and algorithm envelope, exact input-read provenance, served-row and pending-job freshness. Goal comes from the dated goal snapshot. Unknowns, partial contributions and stale data stay as dashes with a reason. No prior-night attainment.

blocks.name: OBSleepSchedule
blocks.notes: G2 raised twin time wells for stored bedtime estimate and typical wake time; no alarm mutation or cycle-alignment claim. Missing times stay absent. Large text stacks the same two values.

blocks.name: OBAdaptiveValues
blocks.notes: One shared pair for Overview, Sleep and Health. Equal-width row with10gap; full-width vertical cards when scaled14px text exceeds20px. Preserves values and supports large text without shrinking.

blocks.name: OBCalendarLine
blocks.notes: Shared calendar-slot numeric line for stored temperature and the explicitly labelled journal-weight EWMA. Consecutive finite slots connect directly; actual gaps stay empty. Callers select signed zero-centered SD or absolute kilograms/Celsius. No metric computation or unit inference. Measured scaled labels set the gutter; existing temperature geometry is preserved when labels fit.

blocks.name: OBBackupImportReceipt
blocks.notes: Canonical ImportReport card reused for durable restore counts, conflicts, unreadable entries and pending recalculation. Implementation/native acceptance is tracked in the release-data queue.

blocks.name: OBCheckInAsk
blocks.notes: Heute check-in for the typed G3 questions: yes/no (OBYesNoKeys), 1–5 rating (OBRatingKeys), count with explicit Keins (OBCountAnswer) and note (OBNoteAnswer), with a 'zu gestern' line when the answer belongs to the previous day. Paper's OBCheckIn has no slot for the answer's day, so this has no Paper node; requested as a Baustein variant on Bausteine · G3. Count and note controls swap to the Journal's parts at integration.
